description: The conforming and FHA loan limits for the counties a five-digit ZIP code falls in, for the 2026 published schedule, as freerateupdate.com publishes them at https://www.freerateupdate.com/loan-limits. Each limit carries the official source it came from (FHFA for conforming, HUD for FHA) and, when a check has run, the date that source was last confirmed. These are published limits, not advice: a limit is not a rate, an approval or an offer, and eligibility depends on the lender and the loan.
name: get_loan_limits
title: Conforming and FHA loan limits for a ZIP code
